text: Pikoo's... Locked-Up Snacks!
spoken_en: Pikoo's... Locked-Up Snacks!

text: At the Shellfish Cafe, somebody has locked the snack cupboard... And the café needs to be opened for the day!
spoken_en: At the Shellfish Cafe, somebody has locked the snack cupboard... And the café needs to be opened for the day!

text: Someone locked away all the snacks. Who was it?
spoken_en: Someone locked away all the snacks. Who was it?

text: Wasn't me! ...Probably.
spoken_en: Wasn't me! ...Probably.

text: There are three locks... that means we have to solve all three levels to open up the snack shelf and to find out WHO locked the snacks.
spoken_en: There are three locks... that means we have to solve all three levels to open up the snack shelf and to find out WHO locked the snacks.

text: Seven little pins. Tap the bigger number and a pin pops loose!
spoken_en: Seven little pins. Tap the bigger number and a pin pops loose!

text: Tap the bigger number - a pin pops loose.
spoken_en: Tap the bigger number - a pin pops loose.

text: Oops! Try Again.
spoken_en: Oops! Try Again.

text: Count the digits first. Same length? Then compare the digits from the left until they are different.
spoken_en: Count the digits first. Same length? Then compare the digits from the left until they are different.

text: Take your time - tap the one you think is right.
spoken_en: Take your time - tap the one you think is right.

text: Pop! First pin open - easy!
spoken_en: Pop! First pin open - easy!

text: Same length - you checked the front. Good.
spoken_en: Same length - you checked the front. Good.

text: Another one loose!
spoken_en: Another one loose!

text: The big 9 did not fool you. Nice.
spoken_en: The big nine did not fool you. Nice.

text: So close - but you got it!
spoken_en: So close - but you got it!

text: Whoa, a six-digit one - pop!
spoken_en: Whoa, a six-digit one - pop!

text: Last pin. Lock one is open!
spoken_en: Last pin. Lock one is open!

text: The bigger one is 48,210 - tap it.
spoken_en: The bigger one is forty-eight thousand two hundred ten - tap it.

text: The bigger one is 57,282 - tap it.
spoken_en: The bigger one is fifty-seven thousand two hundred eighty-two - tap it.

text: The bigger one is 46,310 - tap it.
spoken_en: The bigger one is forty-six thousand three hundred ten - tap it.

text: The bigger one is 12,040 - tap it.
spoken_en: The bigger one is twelve thousand forty - tap it.

text: The bigger one is 90,000 - tap it.
spoken_en: The bigger one is ninety thousand - tap it.

text: The bigger one is 1,05,789 - tap it.
spoken_en: The bigger one is one lakh five thousand seven hundred eighty-nine - tap it.

text: The bigger one is 1,20,728 - tap it.
spoken_en: The bigger one is one lakh twenty thousand seven hundred twenty-eight - tap it.

text: Bravo!! One lock down.
spoken_en: Bravo!! One lock down.

text: Yayy!! Two more to go!
spoken_en: Yayy!! Two more to go!

text: Biggest and smallest, every time. One lock left.
spoken_en: Biggest and smallest, every time. One lock left.

text: Whoever locked this really cares about snacks, huh...
spoken_en: Whoever locked this really cares about snacks, huh...

text: Make it the BIGGEST!
spoken_en: Make it the BIGGEST!

text: ...and the smallest. This lock wants BOTH.
spoken_en: ...and the smallest. This lock wants BOTH.

text: Make the BIGGEST number from these shells: 5, 2, 8, 1. Drag them into the windows, then press Enter.
spoken_en: Make the BIGGEST number from these shells: five, two, eight, one. Drag them into the windows, then press Enter.

text: Make the SMALLEST number from these shells: 5, 2, 8, 1. Drag them into the windows, then press Enter.
spoken_en: Make the SMALLEST number from these shells: five, two, eight, one. Drag them into the windows, then press Enter.

text: Make the BIGGEST number from these shells: 4, 0, 7, 3. Drag them into the windows, then press Enter.
spoken_en: Make the BIGGEST number from these shells: four, zero, seven, three. Drag them into the windows, then press Enter.

text: Make the SMALLEST number from these shells: 4, 0, 7, 3. Drag them into the windows, then press Enter.
spoken_en: Make the SMALLEST number from these shells: four, zero, seven, three. Drag them into the windows, then press Enter.

text: Make the BIGGEST number from these shells: 6, 2, 9, 5, 1. Drag them into the windows, then press Enter.
spoken_en: Make the BIGGEST number from these shells: six, two, nine, five, one. Drag them into the windows, then press Enter.

text: Make the SMALLEST number from these shells: 6, 2, 9, 5, 1. Drag them into the windows, then press Enter.
spoken_en: Make the SMALLEST number from these shells: six, two, nine, five, one. Drag them into the windows, then press Enter.

text: Make the BIGGEST (MASTER) number from these shells: 7, 0, 4, 2, 9, 1. Drag them into the windows, then press Enter.
spoken_en: Make the BIGGEST (MASTER) number from these shells: seven, zero, four, two, nine, one. Drag them into the windows, then press Enter.

text: Biggest - nice and tall!
spoken_en: Biggest - nice and tall!

text: And the smallest. Both - that is how it likes it.
spoken_en: And the smallest. Both - that is how it likes it.

text: Biggest again!
spoken_en: Biggest again!

text: Smallest - and you kept 0 out of the front. Sharp.
spoken_en: Smallest - and you kept zero out of the front. Sharp.

text: Five shells - biggest, done!
spoken_en: Five shells - biggest, done!

text: Smallest, snug!
spoken_en: Smallest, snug!

text: The master code - a whole lakh. Keypad is open!
spoken_en: The master code - a whole lakh. Keypad is open!

text: Biggest digit in front, then the next biggest.
spoken_en: Biggest digit in front, then the next biggest.

text: Smallest digit in front, then the next smallest.
spoken_en: Smallest digit in front, then the next smallest.

text: Smallest digit in front - but 0 cannot lead!
spoken_en: Smallest digit in front - but zero cannot lead!

text: Set it like this - 8,521. Then press Enter.
spoken_en: Set it like this - eight thousand five hundred twenty-one. Then press Enter.

text: Set it like this - 1,258. Then press Enter.
spoken_en: Set it like this - one thousand two hundred fifty-eight. Then press Enter.

text: Set it like this - 7,430. Then press Enter.
spoken_en: Set it like this - seven thousand four hundred thirty. Then press Enter.

text: Set it like this - 3,047. Then press Enter.
spoken_en: Set it like this - three thousand forty-seven. Then press Enter.

text: Set it like this - 96,521. Then press Enter.
spoken_en: Set it like this - ninety-six thousand five hundred twenty-one. Then press Enter.

text: Set it like this - 12,569. Then press Enter.
spoken_en: Set it like this - twelve thousand five hundred sixty-nine. Then press Enter.

text: Set it like this - 9,74,210. Then press Enter.
spoken_en: Set it like this - nine lakh seventy-four thousand two hundred ten. Then press Enter.

text: This locker has seven shell-shaped bulbs. Arrange each set of numbers in order and one shell-bulb lights up.
spoken_en: This locker has seven shell-shaped bulbs. Arrange each set of numbers in order and one shell-bulb lights up.

text: Arrange the numbers in ascending order (smallest to biggest). Tap them in order - each correct one lights a shell-bulb on the locker.
spoken_en: Arrange the numbers in ascending order (smallest to biggest). Tap them in order - each correct one lights a shell-bulb on the locker.

text: Arrange the numbers in descending order (biggest to smallest). Tap them in order - each correct one lights a shell-bulb on the locker.
spoken_en: Arrange the numbers in descending order (biggest to smallest). Tap them in order - each correct one lights a shell-bulb on the locker.

text: Small to big - first shell-bulb lights up!
spoken_en: Small to big - first shell-bulb lights up!

text: Same digits - but you read past the front. Good.
spoken_en: Same digits - but you read past the front. Good.

text: Another shell-bulb glows!
spoken_en: Another shell-bulb glows!

text: Now big to small - clean.
spoken_en: Now big to small - clean.

text: The lakh ones - in order!
spoken_en: The lakh ones - in order!

text: Almost there - nearly all lit!
spoken_en: Almost there - nearly all lit!

text: Last shell-bulb - they all glow now!
spoken_en: Last shell-bulb - they all glow now!

text: Find the smallest number still out, and tap that next.
spoken_en: Find the smallest number still out, and tap that next.

text: Find the biggest number still out, and tap that next.
spoken_en: Find the biggest number still out, and tap that next.

text: This one comes next.
spoken_en: This one comes next.

text: The last shell-bulb lights up - all seven shell-bulbs glow and the locker clicks open; a note flies down.
spoken_en: The last shell-bulb lights up - all seven shell-bulbs glow and the locker clicks open; a note flies down.

text: 'Snacks arranged and locked. - Pikoo.' It was you, Pikoo!
spoken_en: 'Snacks arranged and locked. - Pikoo.' It was you, Pikoo!

text: OH. Right! I organised them this morning... and locked them... and forgot. Heh.
spoken_en: OH. Right! I organised them this morning... and locked them... and forgot. Heh.

text: The cafe is saved!
spoken_en: The cafe is saved!

text: Bravo! The cafe can finally open. The doors swing open and a happy crowd of sea-creatures walks in for their snacks!
spoken_en: Bravo! The cafe can finally open. The doors swing open and a happy crowd of sea-creatures walks in for their snacks!
